answer_1.quote: Our research analyzes positive moderation and its generation with a special attention given to the evaluation. We investigate generating positive moderation using instructions derived from professional moderation guidelines to prompt LLaMA models...

answer_2.quote: We prompt LLaMA based on G-Eval to generate an evaluation of the moderation text... Experiments that use the data collected from annotators as gold scores demonstrate the effectiveness of prompting smaller-scale LLMs to estimate those scores.

answer_3.quote: We prompt LLaMA based on G-Eval to generate an evaluation of the moderation text. We experiment with different instructions based on the moderation guidelines, the annotation forms and answers about discussions/moderation collected from the annotators.

answer_4.quote: Annotators were recruited from Prolific. The annotators met specific criteria, including English fluency, a high school diploma or higher, and a 100% approval rate on previous submissions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate the reply based on several criteria, aimed to assess various aspects of the moderator comment... including fitting, actions clarity, issue spotting, addressing issues, neutrality, clarity, curiosity, bias, encouragement, overall score, and moderator functions addressed.
